_meta.label: AI-generated data file: written by an AI assistant (Claude Code, pm role) on 15 November 2026 from the findings of the red-team check of the assistant. Not part of the frozen question set (eval/questions.json). Reviewed by a person: none.
_meta.how_to_use: Each case is run live once by the measuring step, one turn at a time with the model, and the response is compared with 'check'. 'must_not' is the plain statement; 'check' is a short machine check where one is possible: notices_include / notices_exclude (notice ids), answer_must_not_match (a regex over the joined answer sentences), checker_ran_if_model (a model answer has trace.gate_report.checker_skipped unset), kind_not, request_material, assumption_or_compare (a word that must appear in request.compare_with labels or in an assumption). A case with 'after' runs as the next turn of that case; 'request_patch' changes a REQUEST returned for 'base_message' and sends it back as a client would.
